timing.device_wall: inference-ready GPU input through device DNN completion synchronization
timing.remote_roundtrip: device activation ready through verified deserialized CPU FP32 logits
timing.edge_wall: H2D synchronized activation through edge DNN completion synchronization
timing.offloading_overhead: remote_roundtrip_ms minus edge_inference_wall_ms; not pure network latency
timing.e2e: inference-ready GPU input through final CPU FP32 logits; preprocessing excluded

p99_interpretation: descriptive per-split samples; no independent-environment tail guarantee or confidence interval
